paper.title: A General Adaptive Dual-level Weighting Mechanism for Remote Sensing Pansharpening
paper.authors: Jie Huang, Haorui Chen, Jiaxuan Ren, Siran Peng, Liangjian Deng

main_model: LAGNet + ADWM (upstream/model/bwnet_lagconv_sota.py BWNet; paper section 3.2 and supplement B)

WV3.chosen_by: file name, fixed before any evaluation

upstream/weights/BWNET_FusionNet_WV3/mod.note: replaced in upstream commit aa185a6; has the LAGNet + ADWM keys and different values, not FusionNet; recorded only

author_weights.redistribution: not copied; used through the pinned upstream submodule
author_weights.training_split: not stated by the authors (paper: PanCollection)

inputs: ms (LR, DN / scale) and pan; the network upsamples ms by bicubic inside; lms not used
output: clipped to 0-1 at inference as official main_test.py; unclipped in training and validation as main_train.py

author.layernorm_note: the WV3 weights lack the 14 LayerNorm tensors of the official class; 'identity' (no LayerNorm) or 'default' (weight 1, bias 0) is chosen by WV3 validation L1 (train.py author-select), never by test

retrain.epochs_source: paper supplement D (QB 200; GF2 same as WV3, 500). Issue #183 listed the official default 500 for both
retrain.scheduler: StepLR step_size 150, gamma 0.5, built as official with initial_lr and last_epoch=0: halved rate from epoch index 149, 299, 449

ifw_hidden.QB: 0.6n = 29 (paper; official code fixes 0.8n, rebuilt in model.py)

retrain.selection: minimum validation L1 after every epoch on the whole validation set (team rule; official: every 10 epochs, no selection)
retrain.recompute: only if batch 64 does not fit in GPU memory; BatchNorm statistics are saved and restored so the result is unchanged

training_place: Kaggle GPU T4 x2 (QB on GPU 0, GF2 on GPU 1), sessions of about 6 hours resumed from latest.pt

paper_reported.source: paper Table 1 and supplement Table 5; GPU GTX 3090
